title: Container closeout can miss open descendants when dependency projection is stale
description: Evidence: closeout gate dependencyDescendants traverses stored dependencyIds only, while other surfaces treat blocks graph edges as canonical and can repair projection drift. Impact: a container can close while open child work exists in canonical graph edges but not dependencyIds.
acceptanceCriteria: Container closeout derives descendants from canonical graph edges or repairs/verifies projection freshness before gate evaluation, with a stale dependencyIds regression.
